title: No Instructions Included
text: No Instructions Included. This could have been a 5 star review if they would include some instructions on use besides a small diagram on the box. I figured it out, but it annoys me enough that I deduct stars when I have to do that. I plan to use this for making feta cheese in place of a large press.

product_metadata.title: Tofu Press Large Size, Trobing Tofu Presser for 12-16 oz Bricks Firm Tofu or Extra Firm Tofu, Improve Flavor and Texture, Tofu Drainer Mess-free Design DIY Tofu Maker, Dishwasher Safe
features: LARGER CAPACITY: The inner draining tub measures 2.16*4.7*5.9 inches and can easily fit a standard block of firm or extra firm tofu, suitable for 12-16 oz bricks of tofu.

DRAINS AUTOMATICALLY: it gets the job done with no mess, no fuss, and - unlike some other versions – no need to keep re-tightening screws to get more water out. Just add your tofu the night before you want to eat it, or in the morning before you go to work, and it'll be ready to use when you get home.

SIMPLE THREE-PIECE DESIGN: built-in with drainage holes in the bottom let water drip into the collecting tray, while the corner feet keep your tofu clear of the water below. The white tray at the bottom collects any water pressed out of the tofu, which can be poured away without having to take the press apart.

EASY TO CLEAN: The press consists of 3 parts and a spring that are essential for it to work. The whole construction is made of plastic is durable and safe, It only takes twenty seconds to clean it. It is also dishwasher safe, so you don't have to waste your time cleaning it.

SAFE AND EASY TO USE: the Trobing Tofu Press uses a powerful spring to squeeze out unwanted moisture in a stress-free, mess-free fashion. It's constructed with BPA-free plastic approved for food use, so you can confidently start concocting healthy Vegetarian meals.
